introduction.title: A New Way to Understand Ecology
introduction.description: Traditional learning can make the vibrant processes of energy flow and ecological succession seem abstract. This project bridges that gap, transforming fundamental ecological theories into clear, engaging, and interactive learning experiences.

concepts.subtitle: Explore the fundamental concepts that drive ecosystem dynamics

primarySuccession.description: See how life begins on barren, lifeless land.

secondarySuccession.title: Secondary Succession
secondarySuccession.description: Witness how ecosystems recover from disturbances.

biodiversity.title: Biodiversity
biodiversity.description: Understand the importance of variety in an ecosystem.

decomposers.title: Decomposers
decomposers.description: Learn the critical role of nutrient recycling.

showcase.title: Witness Ecological Succession Unfold
showcase.description: Go beyond static diagrams. Slide through time to see a barren landscape evolve into a stable, climax community right before your eyes.

rationale.title: Rationale & Contribution
rationale.paragraph1: Understanding ecosystems is crucial for appreciating our planet's health and making informed environmental decisions.
rationale.paragraph2: This project serves as a valuable educational resource, providing a clear, structured explanation of ecological principles to encourage environmental awareness and support academic learning.

quote.text: Harmony with land is like harmony with a friend; you cannot cherish his right hand and chop off his left.
